title: Iitaka subadditivity, variation, and logarithmic additivity

result.label: Iitaka subadditivity, variation, and logarithmic additivity
result.statement: Proves Campana's orbifold Iitaka subadditivity conjecture for smooth Fujiki-class- C manifolds with rational simple-normal-crossing boundaries. For projective fibrations f:U V of smooth complex quasi-projective varieties with connected fibers, general fiber F , and (V) 0, proves Popa's inequality (U) (F)+ (V), Var (f) , where variation measures the whole geometric generic fiber.
